era: Miraheze 2019: every Miraheze wiki ran MediaWiki with the Vector skin (the legacy Vector that Wikipedia used until 2022): grey page with the wiki logo top left, left sidebar portlets (Navigation, community sections, Tools), Main Page / Discussion and Read / View source / View history tabs with More and the search box, personal tools at the top right, a white content column with the table of contents, the cookie notice (More information / OK) and the footer with licence, Privacy policy, About, Disclaimers, Terms of Use, Mobile view and the Powered by MediaWiki badge. Arquivo.pt captures of meta.miraheze.org Apr, Jun and Dec 2019; MediaWiki's Special:Search page from Arquivo.pt captures of the same software (Vector) in 2019. The live site is behind Cloudflare, so the inventory was taken read-only in the user's Chrome with the inventory collector; the theme reloads Vector 2022 pages with useskin=vector.

sources.shows: Meta main page in Vector: More information / OK cookie notice, Jump to navigation / Jump to search, Our commitment, News, Contact us, Contribute, language links, Navigation menu, Personal tools (English, Talk, Contributions, Create account, Log in), Namespaces (Main page, Discussion), Variants, Views (Read, View source, View history), More, Search Meta field, Navigation (Recent changes, Random page), Requests (Request features on a wiki, Requests for adoption), Noticeboards (Community noticeboard, Stewards' noticeboard), Tools (What links here, Related changes, Special pages, Printable version, Permanent link, Page information, Cite this page, Get shortened URL), Donate to Miraheze, CC BY-SA 4.0, Privacy policy, About Meta, Disclaimers, Terms of Use, Mobile view
